out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handsink to the right of the cook line did not have any running water.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC TURNED ON THE HOT WATER. HOT WATER AT THIS HAND SINK WAS OBSERVED AT 100f. KEEP ALL HANDSINKS TURNED ON TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Paper towels were not observed at the hand sink to the right of the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PLACE PAPER TOWELS AT THIS HAND SINK. ALL HAND SINKS MUST HAVE PAPER TOWELS TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Hand soap was not observed at the hand sink to the right of the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC PLACED HAND SOAP AT THIS HAND SINK.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: 1) a box of Raw chicken was observed being stored over Raw ground beef in the 2DR upright, Meat cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). PIC MOVED THE RAW CHICKEN TO THE BOTTOM SHELF OF THE COOLER. THIS VIOLATION HAS BEEN CORRECTED.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 2DR under counter, milk cooler: 2% milk (45f), half and half (46f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE DARIY PRODUCTS. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION. ENFORCEMENT MAY BE WARRANTED IF THIS CONTINUES. Roots Provisions & Grocery (Inspection Date: 08/24/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the PRINTED MENU with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: 1) fried egg; 2) burger
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PLACE A CONSUMER ADVISORY ASTERISK * NEXT TO ALL FOOD ITEMS THAT ARE OFFERED UNDERCOOKED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed multiple unlabeled spray bottle of cleaning products throughout the both kitchens
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. LABEL ALL CHEMICAL BOTTLES.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Observed insect control devices for drain flies on top of the paper towel dispenser, on a shelf with bread, and on the coffee bar counter.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. MOVE ALL INSECT CONTROL DEVICES AWAY FROM FOOD PREPARATION AREAS TO AVOID CONTAMINATION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers mayonnaise and hot honey were observed reused for the storage of oils and dressings.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. DO NOT REUSE MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS. USE NSF-APPROVED FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS

violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. SEAL WOOD SHELVES TO MAKE IT NONABSORBENT AND CLEANABLE.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: 1) in the grab and go cooler; iced tea, salads, yogurt parfaits, and fruit cups were observed without a date marked label. The aforementioned foods were made in-house.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PLEASE DATE MARK ALL PREPARED FOODS MARKETED FOR RETAIL SALE. SELL OF DISCARD WITHIN 7 DAYS. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. EHS observed no written procedures on site.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS GAVE PIC THE ENGLISH AND SPANISH VERSIONS OF THE FAIRFAX COUNTY VOMIT AND DIARRHEA POLICY HANDOUT.
